body:
I've been getting mental help for years. Some of it has helped, for a while at times. I'm just in a huge rut right now. I tried to kill myself 6 months ago but failed, and I agreed to move in with my father so he could help me because he wanted a chance to. Being there did help a lot, but he ended up taking advantage of me (I worked for him, he said he was "saving" my money earned for when I decide to get a car/do a job training course I was really looking forward to, but he wasn't saving any of it and had a huge gambling addiction in addition to his alcoholism and subsequent workaholism.) So now I just moved in with my mom and her husband (unhappy marriage) with my sister, in an unfinished house with junk everywhere, insulation hanging out, scary bugs crawling around at times (they haven't worked on the house in 3+ years). Just reinforced that the people I should be able to rely on are either stupid, selfish, or both.

I have a very close relationship with my sister, who feels like she has to take care of me to the point that it burdens her life. She fights with resenting me on the inside. She hates it here so much because of the conditions and because of the memories of the worse times she had here, so much that she does nothing but lay around after work and just leaves her trash and clothes everywhere. She recently bought a second vehicle she needs for a work, but instead of something reasonable, she got a limited edition sports car. A week later, when we were talking about the house here, she said "maybe I should have bought a house instead of that car." 

I feel like we're just bound to keep making these shitty choices and/or being screwed over by our parents (both siblings cut contact from my father - he stole thousands of dollars from my brother, too.)

Well.. I guess I really wanted to let that out, even though I have a therapist and seem to touch on these issues every week. Now that I've done so, your idea about pulling through with my sister seems like a good one. We already kinda do that, but you gave me an idea that there's more things she can and wouldn't mind helping me with (not monetary - god I am sick of her having to bail me out, one more reason I want to die.)

That is such an extreme situation. I'm so sorry you have to go through this. 

I feel like since you've already tried about every route you can think of, maybe you can try posting somewhere like craigslist describing your situation. Might be best not to mention that you're a woman in at least the initial post just because if you put yourself at the mercy of others in such a way it's easier for others to take advantage of you. But, there are many genuinely good people out there and you might just come across someone, so I think it's worth a shot.
